name: homehub

scripts.lint:api: uv sync --all-packages --dev && uv run --directory services/api ruff check . && uv run --directory services/api ruff format --check . && uv run --directory services/api mypy
scripts.test:api: uv sync --all-packages --dev && uv run --directory services/api pytest
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm lint:api && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

description: HomeHub — smart home IoT hub with REST API, DynamoDB, Cognito, and SST IaC
